# Interface IPdmVisualization

Gives access to the Visualization.

###### Namespace: TopSolid.Pdm.Explorer.Automating

###### Assembly: TopSolid.Pdm.Explorer.Automating.dll

##### Syntax

```
[ServiceContract]
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 20, 222, 0)]
public interface IPdmVisualization
```

##### Remarks

This interface is available since v7.20.

### Methods 

|  Name |  Description |  
| --- | --- | 
   
|   GetViews(PdmMinorRevisionId)  |  Gets the graphic views of a PdmObject.  |  
 
|   SetViewCameraOrientation(PdmMinorRevisionId, int, CameraViewOrientation, bool)  |  Sets top camera for this document view  |  
 
|   ZoomToFit(PdmMinorRevisionId, int)  |  Method to zoom to fit view  |
